posts.text:
Accurate weather forecasting starts with how clearly we can observe the atmosphere in real-time. 

That’s why we’re releasing PARDIG and SatWeave - the foundational datasets behind WeatherNext 3 - to help researchers and developers build new climate applications

posts.author: GoogleDeepMind
posts.name: Google DeepMind
posts.text:
What’s under the hood:
 PARDIG: Estimates global rainfall every 15 minutes, while improving precipitation detection skill by more than 30%.
 SatWeave: Combines several geostationary satellites into one live view of Earth’s clouds and storms every 60 minutes.
